name: UI Layer
description: Next.js App Router entry points, the long-form workshop page composition, and all presentational React components plus global styles that render Tiyana's workshop experience.

name: Utility Layer
description: Shared client-side helper that copies text to the clipboard and triggers the confetti burst used by the interactive code block.

name: Configuration Layer
description: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and PostCSS build configuration plus the generated Next.js type declaration that define how the site compiles and is styled.

name: Documentation Layer
description: Project README and the non-technical step-by-step editing guide that help Tiyana run and update the workshop page.
